components.name: Search Field
components.description: Actual Pagefind field geometry with Starlight typography and focus border; search behavior stays with Pagefind.
components.html: <label class="ds-search-field-label">Поиск<input class="ds-search-field" type="search" placeholder="Поиск по документации" /></label>
components.css: .ds-search-field-label { color: var(--sl-color-gray-2, #c3c8d1); font-family: var(--__sl-font, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif); } .ds-search-field { display: block; width: 100%; height: calc(64px * var(--pagefind-ui-scale, 0.8)); padding: 0 calc(70px * var(--pagefind-ui-scale, 0.8)) 0 calc(54px * var(--pagefind-ui-scale, 0.8)); border: 1px solid var(--sl-color-gray-5, #363b44); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--sl-color-black, hsl(224, 10%, 10%)); color: var(--sl-color-white, #ffffff); font-family: var(--__sl-font, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif); font-size: calc(21px * var(--pagefind-ui-scale, 0.8)); font-weight: 400; } .ds-search-field::placeholder { opacity: 0.2; } .ds-search-field:focus { border-color: var(--sl-color-accent, hsl(200, 85%, 55%)); } .ds-search-field:focus-visible { outline: auto; }

narrative.overview:
This system applies to the documentation subproject at `/wiki/`. It uses the native Starlight reading shell: persistent documentation hierarchy, an article column, page contents, local search, and theme and language controls. The visual emphasis is the article; the Potok blue accent identifies links and the current location.

The source of truth is `src/styles/potok.css` for local overrides and the installed Starlight styles for inherited behavior. Frontmatter captures the current reused values; it is a documentation snapshot, not a second stylesheet. Update it when those sources change. The parent media application and the embedded sandbox retain their own design system in `../src/styles/variables.css`, `../src/styles/ui.css`, and `../src/styles/sandbox.css`.
keyCharacteristics: Calm neutral surfaces in light and dark themes.
System typography and a bounded reading column.
Native Starlight navigation, search, and article hierarchy.
App-owned operational controls inside the sandbox frame.

rules.name: The Semantic Theme Rule
rules.body: Use Starlight's text, background, accent, and hairline variables for components so both themes keep the correct role assignments.

dos: **Do** reuse native Starlight components and semantic theme variables.
**Do** preserve the 72ch article measure, wrapped examples, and locally scrollable reference tables.
**Do** retain visible keyboard focus and native mobile navigation.
**Do** keep sandbox controls and SDK previews consistent with the parent application's atomic components.
donts: **Don't** replace the reading shell with a second custom navigation or card system.
**Don't** copy the docs tokens into the parent media application or replace sandbox tokens with Starlight tokens.
**Don't** introduce decorative assets, display fonts, or accent families absent from the implemented system.
**Don't** import React or Monaco into ordinary documentation pages.
